reviews.text: Took my dog to groom on yesterday and this place was excellent.I recommend it to everyone one ... Thank you Precious and snoopy pet salon...
Love the service
Made our dogs look very cute and put together!

Just wanted to say a huge THANK YOU!! For taking such great care of my Sky girl. She came home looking and smelling amazing. Will definitely be going back and keeping up with her grooming with you guy’s for sure 👌🏻
Our dog looked so much better and she seemed very happy with her new look
Always an incredible experience at Precious and Snoopy Salon! The staff is  friendly, professional and so gentle with my 2 pups. My pups leave looking and feeling amazing.

We have two adopted babies who come from rescues, one is a Great Pyrenees and I’d really tried to keep up with his grooming because times are tight and he is hard to drive places- as he is a big boy. But we brought him here to Precious and Snoopy and she took care of him and our half husky breed so darn well. They were washed and groomed, nails, ears, romps! I mean they look like proper store bought dogs! Lol. I mean the owner lady is amazing and super knowledgeable and caring. You can tell she loves animals and to boot her prices are very fair. I definitely highly recommend these guys. They are amazing! Tip them well! The good ones need to feel the love of us customers! There’s so many over priced run of the mill grooming places. This one is definitely a small business and I love that! Thank you team! We love everything you do! And we love the little adorable scarves you put on our babies every time! They look so stylish when they’re done!

This was my first time bringing my dog here and I was very pleased! The staff is very friendly. Their work is great. They take their time with each dog to ensure they have the best groom possible. I will definitely be bringing my dog back.

I took my dog ​​to Martha, and the experience was excellent. She was incredibly kind, patient, and dedicated to her work. My dog ​​had a lot of matted fur, and she still did everything she could to avoid cutting too much and to make her look as beautiful as possible. You can see the love and care she puts into her work. Highly recommended.

Martha was incredibly kind and patient with my dog. She took all the time she needed to make her look beautiful, and even though she had a lot of knots, she made a great effort to avoid cutting too much of her fur. You can tell she works with a lot of love and dedication. We were very happy with the result and definitely recommend her. Thank you, Martha!
She did my English cocker spaniel and he looks absolutely wonderful and beautiful!!!! I’m very nervous and particular with him and she completely understood and did wonderful.
Amazing grooming ! My dog came out beautiful

I had a very unpleasant experience; every time the family pet was taken away, it would come back very breathless, fearful, scared, and with very slow movement, and the next day it would have a lot of dandruff.
First time here and loved the service! Great job done and super cute accessories, definitely recommend.
The absolute BEST groomer EVER!!  We’ve been to multiple groomers in the past but will never go to another. Precious & Snoopy is our groomer for life!!
I’m so glad that I found this pet salon! My dachshund gets very anxious when he gets groomed but they were so patient and kind with him. Their grooming packages were very affordable too!
My babie is so happy and cute!!!
My dog is perfect! Bentley was super excited!
Excellent service and very kind treatment for my little Lucy.
A good experience for my little Lucy, good service.
Always do a great job!

I’ve been going to Martha for 5 years now and I recommend her to every dog owner I come across! She leaves my two dogs looking absolutely beautiful!! I’ve never had a complaint to how they come out, I keep them on a 6 week rotation. She treat my dogs with such good care, they are always so happy to go off in her care. She is very affordable for a dog owner of two and i can’t emphasize enough how good my dogs smell as well.
Thank you

We took our girl Peach to get her first time grooming done by Martha today and she came out perfectly poofed and sooo happy! She took really good care of our little poodle and we will definitely be bringing her back, thank you so much 💗 …
Great job!!!

WE LOVE Martha! We have been to Martha since she 1st started the salon. She was the only one who could handle my dog who is now passed. But I now bring her my husky. She did a great job an he looks amazing! Customer service is great!
Thank you so much
Amazing job with my golden doodle
Thank you
i’ve been taking my dogs here for years!  they do a great job, and the dogs are happy.  my puppy get so many compliments, and I love to tell them where I take them. Great service great price!
I always bring Candy here because it's the best place to pamper her. I recommend it 100%.
Love this place for my pets to get groom, they seem to enjoy it and the staff is friendly 😁😁 5⭐ for me 😁 …
We love Ms. Marta! My dog had been kicked out of several groomers because of his anxiety but here he loves it and they leave him so cute!
Precious & Snoopy do a great job of grooming my pet dog.
